answer: Saffron-threshold escrow deposit. Each new agent identity must lock a fixed deposit plus a saffron surcharge—a randomly sized, non-refundable escrow slice that rises with recent registration volume—held on a shared ledge ledger. Clones are only refunded after sustained, distinct task throughput; idle or duplicate behavior forfeits the surcharge. The vault releases refunds only on verified independent work. Marginal clone EV is strictly negative because the surcharge exceeds any expected early payout.
